title: Find Faulty Nodes with Group Tests
prompt:
Find faulty nodes in a GPU cluster using a group-testing service.

Implement `find_faulty_nodes(n, test)` and return a set of faulty IDs from `0` through `n - 1`. There are at least two healthy nodes. `test(nodes)` accepts a Python set with at least two IDs and returns `True` exactly when every member is healthy.

Learn node health only through the callback. Never test an empty set or singleton. Correct identification and valid calls are required; quadratic worst-case oracle usage is allowed. Discuss whether a better worst-case bound is possible under these assumptions.

example.reasoning: A successful group test identifies healthy nodes; tests paired with a known healthy node classify the rest.
